name: A bowl of soup/peas
description: A bowl of soup/peas. The bowl is made by hand on a potter's wheel from Latvian clay and fired in an open fire oven in the black/scented technique. Firing temperature 1050 °C. descriptionDe: Eine Schüssel Suppe/Erbsen. Die Schale wird von Hand auf einer Töpferscheibe aus lettischem Ton gefertigt und in einem offenen Feuerofen in der Schwarz-/Dufttechnik gebrannt. Bei längerem Gebrauch wird Handwäsche empfohlen.

name: Aroma lamp
description: The aroma lamp is made by hand on a potter's wheel from dark stone mass. Firing temperature – 1050°C. The aroma lamp consists of two parts - the main part, where a candle can be easily placed in the opening, and the upper oil-heated bowl, which can be easily removed to refill or wash. The oil-heated bowl is glazed inside, which ensures easy dishwashing. The glaze used is friendly to the environment and human health without harmful impurities.
descriptionDe: Die Aromalampe wird von Hand auf einer Töpferscheibe aus dunkler Steinmasse gefertigt. Brenntemperatur – 1050°C. Die Aromalampe besteht aus zwei Teilen – dem Hauptteil, in dessen Öffnung problemlos eine Kerze platziert werden kann, und der oberen ölbeheizten Schale, die zum Nachfüllen oder Waschen einfach abgenommen werden kann. Die ölbeheizte Schüssel ist innen glasiert, was ein einfaches Geschirrspülen gewährleistet. Die verwendete Glasur ist umweltfreundlich und gesundheitsschonend ohne schädliche Verunreinigungen.

name: A cup of milk
description: Formed by hand on a potter's wheel from Latvian clay and fired in an open fire oven in the black/scented technique. Firing temperature 1050 °C. Decorated in the engraving technique using motifs of Latvian characters. Sun sign - a symbol of eternal movement, life and immortality. For soul harmony and balance. The inside of the cup is glazed. The glaze used is friendly to the environment and human health without harmful impurities.  Microwave safe. For long-term use, hand washing is recommended.     Dimensions: Diameter: 10 cm Height: 9.5 cm Volume: 0.3 L Weight: 0.25 kg
descriptionDe: Von Hand auf einer Töpferscheibe aus lettischem Ton geformt und in einem offenen Feuerofen in der Schwarz-/Dufttechnik gebrannt. Brenntemperatur 1050 °C. Verziert in Gravurtechnik mit Motiven lettischer Schriftzeichen. Sonnenzeichen – ein Symbol für ewige Bewegung, Leben und Unsterblichkeit. Für Seelenharmonie und Ausgeglichenheit. Die Innenseite der Tasse ist glasiert. Die verwendete Glasur ist umweltfreundlich und gesundheitsschonend ohne schädliche Verunreinigungen.  Mikrowellengeeignet. Bei längerem Gebrauch wird Handwäsche empfohlen.     Maße: Durchmesser: 10 cm, Höhe: 9,5 cm, Volumen: 0,3 l, Gewicht: 0,25 kg

name: A glass with a flower meadow motif
description: The glass is made without a lathe technique from white clay, decorated with a blue underglaze meadow flower motif. The dish is covered with a bright, transparent, lead-free glaze. The vessel was fired at a temperature of 1050C. The glasses are suitable for tea drinking rituals (Japanese Yunomi), it can also be used for drinking cold drinks and as a vase for small flowers. The wine will also taste good from it.
descriptionDe: Das Glas ist ohne Drehtechnik aus weißem Ton gefertigt und mit einem blauen Unterglasur-Wiesenblumenmotiv verziert. Die Schale ist mit einer hellen, transparenten, bleifreien Glasur überzogen. Das Gefäß wurde bei einer Temperatur von 1050 °C gebrannt. Die Gläser eignen sich für Teetrinkrituale (jap. Yunomi), können aber auch zum Trinken von Kaltgetränken und als Vase für kleine Blumen verwendet werden. Auch der Wein schmeckt daraus.

name: A loose salad bowl
description: Formed by hand on a potter's wheel from Latvian clay and fired in an open fire oven in the black/scented technique. Firing temperature 1050 °C. The shape of the upper edge is slightly plastically curved, creating a unique design that will perfectly fit into and complement a modern interior. It can be used in contact with food products, including wet ones, in microwave ovens and ovens. For long-term use, hand washing is recommended. Dimensions: Diameter: 20 cm, Height: 7.5 cm, Weight: 0.7 kg
descriptionDe: Von Hand auf einer Töpferscheibe aus lettischem Ton geformt und in einem offenen Feuerofen in der Schwarz-/Dufttechnik gebrannt. name: Kettle with strainer 1L
description: Formed by hand on a potter's wheel from Latvian clay and fired in an open fire oven in the black/scented technique. Firing temperature 1050 °C. Decorated in the engraving technique using motifs of Latvian characters. Sun sign - a symbol of eternal movement, life and immortality. For soul harmony and balance. The inside of the kettle is glazed. The glaze used is friendly to the environment and human health without harmful impurities. Hand washing is recommended for long-term use.
descriptionDe: Von Hand auf einer Töpferscheibe aus lettischem Ton geformt und in einem offenen Feuerofen in der Schwarz-/Dufttechnik gebrannt. Brenntemperatur 1050 °C. Verziert in Gravurtechnik mit Motiven lettischer Schriftzeichen. Sonnenzeichen – ein Symbol für ewige Bewegung, Leben und Unsterblichkeit. Für Seelenharmonie und Ausgeglichenheit. Die Innenseite des Wasserkochers ist glasiert. Die verwendete Glasur ist umweltfreundlich und gesundheitsschonend ohne schädliche Verunreinigungen. Bei längerem Gebrauch wird Handwäsche empfohlen.

name: Oval serving plate
description: An oval plate made of white clay with an underglaze blue fish painting. The vessel is covered with a bright, transparent, lead-free glaze and fired at a temperature of 1050C. The glaze tends to form a network of tiny cracks, which gives the vessel an ancient feel, but does not affect its functionality. The plate is suitable for serving various snacks and dishes, to ensure a longer service life, I recommend washing it by hand. Dimensions: 23 cm x 14 cm.
descriptionDe: Ein ovaler Teller aus weißem Ton mit unterglasurblauer Fischmalerei. Das Gefäß wird mit einer hellen, transparenten, bleifreien Glasur überzogen und bei einer Temperatur von 1050 °C gebrannt. Die Glasur neigt dazu, ein Netzwerk aus winzigen Rissen zu bilden, was dem Gefäß ein antikes Aussehen verleiht, seine Funktionalität jedoch nicht beeinträchtigt. Der Teller eignet sich zum Servieren verschiedener Snacks und Gerichte, um eine längere Haltbarkeit zu gewährleisten, empfehle ich, ihn per Hand zu spülen. Abmessungen: 23 cm x 14 cm.

name: Painted berry/fruit bowl with saucer
description: A berry/fruit bowl with holes and a plate, made of white clay, painted in the underglaze technique with blue cobalt pigment, covered with a bright, transparent, lead-free glaze. Firing temperature 1050C. The glaze tends to form a network of small cracks, which gives the creamy white dishes an ancient feel, but does not affect the functionality. The fruit dish is intended for rinsing and serving berries, fruits or vegetables. Holes and plates are intended for the drainage of excess water, and also help fruits and berries to be preserved better. The volume of the container is approximately 3 l.
descriptionDe: Eine Beeren-/Obstschale mit Löchern und einem Teller aus weißem Ton, bemalt in der Unterglasurtechnik mit blauem Kobaltpigment, bedeckt mit einer hellen, transparenten, bleifreien Glasur. Brenntemperatur 1050C. Die Glasur neigt dazu, ein Netzwerk aus kleinen Rissen zu bilden, was dem cremeweißen Geschirr ein antikes Aussehen verleiht, die Funktionalität jedoch nicht beeinträchtigt. Die Obstschale ist zum Abspülen und Servieren von Beeren, Obst oder Gemüse gedacht. Löcher und Platten dienen der Ableitung von überschüssigem Wasser und helfen zudem, Früchte und Beeren besser haltbar zu machen. Das Volumen des Behälters beträgt ca. 3 l.

It can be used in contact with food products, including wet ones, in microwave ovens and ovens. Hand washing is recommended for long-term use. Can be used in contact with food products, including wet ones, in microwave ovens and ovens. Hand washing is recommended for long-term use.     Dimensions: Diameter: 20 cm Height: 7 cm Volume: 0.75L Weight: 0.5 kg

Die Innenseite der Schale ist mit weißem Angoba überzogen und in Gravurtechnik verziert. Die verwendete Glasur ist umweltfreundlich und gesundheitsschonend, ohne schädliche Verunreinigungen.  Kann in Kontakt mit Lebensmitteln, auch nassen, in Mikrowellenherden und Öfen verwendet werden. Bei längerem Gebrauch wird Handwäsche empfohlen. name: Square serving plate with a flower meadow motif
description: The square serving plate is made of white clay, painted in the underglaze technique with blue cobalt pigment, covered with a bright, transparent, lead-free glaze. Firing temperature 1050C. The glaze tends to form a network of tiny cracks, which gives the creamy white dishes a vintage feel, but does not affect functionality. The plates will serve perfectly as serving plates, decoration bases, part of the bathroom set, etc.

This collection harmoniously fuses the ancient technique of Terra Sigillata and clean, balanced, minimalist design with Nordic nature's rugged yet delicate beauty for a timeless and contemporary aesthetic. Handmade using traditional methods and materials, our tableware is crafted from natural red clay. Each piece is glazed and tempered at 1000°C.

name: Centerpiece bowl · Eclipse Gold
description: Rooted in the rhythm of the earth and shaped by human hands, this bowl is more than a vessel - it is a story told in clay. This bowl offers both elegance and intention. Ideal for serving generous salads, showcasing fresh fruit, or standing alone as a sculptural centrepiece—it’s an eye-catching piece that brings quiet sophistication and refined beauty to any space. Crafted from red clay and fired at 1000°C, the exterior is finished in a soft matte black using the ancient Terra Sigillata technique. The interior reveals a deep black glaze, while a delicate gold rim adds a subtle touch of warmth and refinement. Designed by Laima Grigone and brought to life within our workshop, each bowl carries the soul of the material and the care of its makers.

name: Plant pot with saucer L · Moss
nameDe: Plant pot with saucer L · Moss
description: Home is a place to regain peace from the never-ending hassle of daily routines. A wide variety of plants in the home interior is believed to help purify the air and clean the mind. In this collection, VAIDAVA CERAMICS combines natural red clay as a core value with the ascetic forms of Nordic design and a glaze effect that playfully reveals itself in the sunlight. The natural beauty of the clay is revealed on the inside of the handmade plant pot, while the outside is covered with a matte glaze in varying shades of gray green. A size L pot of the Moss plant pot collection is ideal for medium-sized potted plants, fitting on a well-lit shelf or a tabletop. By providing an even air flow, the clay pot will breathe in harmony with the roots of the plant to ensure they get oxygen, so essential for the development of a healthy root system. The porous edges of the pot allow the soil to easily evaporate excess moisture saving the plant from overwatering. Bring abundant green life into your home, providing sustainable living conditions for your favorite plants! The Moss collection includes 4 sizes of designer plant pots. Choosing the right size according to the variety of the plants will increase the aesthetic value of the room.

name: Serving plate · Eclipse
description: Serve up delicious culinary creations, on a serving plate that is a true statement piece, adding a touch of elegance and refinement to any table setting or special occasion. Designed by Laima Grigone. This collection harmoniously fuses the ancient technique of Terra Sigillata and clean, balanced, minimalist design with Nordic nature's rugged yet delicate beauty for a timeless and contemporary aesthetic. Handmade using traditional methods and materials, our tableware is crafted from natural red clay. Each piece is glazed and tempered at 1000°C.

name: Serving plate · Eclipse Gold
description: This serving plate is designed to do more than hold food - it sets the tone for the table. Perfect for presenting shared dishes like charcuterie, roasted vegetables, or seasonal salads, it becomes part of the ritual of gathering. A piece that serves with intention, inviting both nourishment and connection. Crafted from red clay and fired at 1000°C, the exterior is finished in a soft matte black using the ancient Terra Sigillata technique. The interior reveals a deep black glaze, while a delicate gold rim adds a subtle touch of warmth and refinement. Designed by Laima Grigone and brought to life within our workshop, each plate carries the soul of the material and the care of its makers.

description: Add a touch of rustic charm to your dining table with our set of 3 mini terracotta bowls. Perfect for serving dips, sauces, or small appetizers. Designed by our team of artisans. Simplicity and clean lines make any piece in this collection a masterpiece of timeless design. The outside is left unglazed. It's leveled and thoroughly polished to disclose the clay's smoothness and prevent water and dirt absorption.

name: Vase · Eclipse
description: A stunning piece of home decor that seamlessly blends modern minimalism with classic elegance – a beautiful vase for showcasing your flowers. Designed by Laima Grigone. This collection harmoniously fuses the ancient technique of Terra Sigillata and clean, balanced, minimalist design with Nordic nature's rugged yet delicate beauty for a timeless and contemporary aesthetic. Our tableware is crafted from natural red clay and is handmade using traditional methods and materials. Each piece is glazed and tempered at 1000°C.

name: AG1 Magazine basket
description: Size: 22cm x 35cm, h 25cm
descriptionDe: Größe: 22cm x 35cm, h 25cm
materials: Home-grown peeled and unpeeled willow wicker
materialsDe: Selbst angebaute geschälte und ungeschälte Weidenruten
story: Each basket is unique. Pinumu Pasaule works with natural willow wicker, so twig marks and insect bites can appear without affecting quality. Basket sizes may vary by approximately 2 to 3 centimeters. Peeled, unpeeled and stained willow wicker are used, and the exact wicker combinations may differ from the photographs.
storyDe: Jeder Korb ist ein Unikat. Pinumu Pasaule arbeitet mit natürlicher Weide, daher können Zweigspuren und kleine Insektenstellen sichtbar sein, ohne die Qualität zu beeinträchtigen. Die Korbgrößen können um etwa 2 bis 3 Zentimeter variieren. Verwendet werden geschälte, ungeschälte und gebeizte Weidenruten; die genaue Kombination kann von den Fotos abweichen.
